notes.text: Abu Nuwas was a classical Arabic poet, and the foremost representative of the modern (muhdath) poetry that developed during the first years of the Abbasid Caliphate.
Abu Nuwas also entered the folkloric tradition, appearing several times in One Thousand and One Nights.
Abu Nuwas is remembered as a writer connected with Iran.
Abu Nuwas's recorded life dates place this profile around 762-814.
Abu Nuwas is grouped with Literature, Arts & Culture in the People Library.
